segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Hello Robert. Tell me about what has been bothering you.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Doctor, I have developed severe right ear pain and a high fever since yesterday. It is throbbing.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Let me examine your ear. The right tympanic membrane is bulging and erythematous. You have acute otitis media.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: What medication can I take to cure this?

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: I am prescribing Amoxicillin 500mg three times daily for 10 days to treat the ear infection.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Okay doctor, I will pick it up from the pharmacy.
